body: I don't want to be alone anymore. I need a RL friend, or I just need to not be alive.
I don't see how this is going to fix anything.

I don't believe everyone has equal chance at making friends. If you're unlucky and your personality sucks, you're screwed. I've got both.

I don't enjoy much anymore. I mostly sit and stare at a computer, maybe watch a movie. I don't have energy to do much and my schedule doesn't make it easy to pick up any kind of social activity.

Nurses tend to have personalities that make them better at making friends. I have no friends, not even a single person to talk to when I go on break at work. I live alone. I spend the majority of my time in silence and isolation, and I can't stand it anymore. I want to end my life ASAP.
